author: Unsurprised
quote:
An unbearably boring cringey psychological torture. 
Does not respect your time or soul seeking escapism. 

This game has the worst story writing I have ever seen in a video game. It is a well engineered phycological torture to play. So boring. 

I played GTA 3, 4, 5 in the months leading up to this game. I have played hundreds of games, maybe a thousand games over 25 years. 

Every time you are enjoying yourself the game has to psychologically punish you with terribleness. You spend most of your time at an extreme mental low point when playing the story mode and getting glimpses of an awesome shooting and driving gameplay, occasionally. An overwhelming majority of this game’s story is garbage. Even good graphics and physics cannot save it. Yeah this game has some glitches but that is to be expected, no big deal. 

That being said I anticipate the multiplayer release for this game but worry that they somehow find a way to make that a psychological torture to play, which I think surely would be almost impossible to mess up! Let’s look forward to multiplayer release I will treat that as a separate release I hope it is a 8+ out of 10 but for this GTA 6 story I am going to give it a 1/10. An unbearable boring cringey psychological torture not worthy of your time or attention. Play the older GTAs or the many other thousands of games available.
